goal: Wire the Pesaje 'Parametros' tab (3-level hierarchy) to the real weighting-params API via react-query hooks (GET/validate/publish), add the mock-server seam, and drop mockData + the 'Mockup' badge.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The Parametros tab shows the 3 volatility levels in order (1 De ejecucion, 2 Insumos versionados, 3 Estaticos/Avanzados) and the advanced level starts collapsed.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: render PesajeParametrosTab, assert level headers present in order and Nivel 3 content hidden until expanded.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Insumos tabs (IdPeso_Config, Variables, Universo) load their data from the API per country (no parametros/mockData.ts). mockData.ts and the orphaned parametros module are removed.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: mock the params api module, assert API rows render; grep shows no import of @/modules/parametros and no mockData.ts file.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Editing IdPeso_Config / Variables + 'Revisar y publicar' calls the real publish endpoint; after a successful publish the StatusPill returns to 'Sin cambios'.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: edit a cell -> StatusPill shows changes -> open review -> confirm -> publish mutation called with draft -> StatusPill shows 'Sin cambios'.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Validation errors from the server validate endpoint are shown inline in the review dialog (row/field/message).
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: mock validate to return errors[{row,field,message}] -> open review -> assert each error message is rendered; publish button blocked.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: mock-server exposes GET idpeso-config/variables/universo, POST {tabla}/validate, POST {tabla}/publish, GET {tabla}/history under /weighting/params/{pais}, and npm run build + npm test + lint + tsc pass.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: node smoke of mock route handlers; npm run build && npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b.
